notes.title: Ilhumia will be removed from Steam
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

An announcement to tell that we will resume the dev of Ilhumia in september.

However, the game will no longer be hosted on steam and we will make a lot of change to improve it.

We will give you more information about the future updates on our twitter. https://twitter.com/ilhumia

Sincerely.

notes.title: Ilhumia - Open Beta
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Ilhumia is currently in open beta and we are happy to show our game to everyone.

But, we already know that few things are not good enough, and we are trying to do our best to improve the game as much as we can thanks to your feedbacks.

So before writing a review, please take into consideration that the game is new  and far from being finished and we will listen to every constructive comments.

If you want to help us, you can use the steam forum and/or join our discord here : https://discordapp.com/invite/acMksmd

We hope that we will be able to build a good and fun game together!

Sincerely.
